description: Sea Level Atmospheric Pressure and Wind Speed at Doha International Airport is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Civil Aviation Authority. Monthly data on the average of the minimum and maximum sea level pressure, Average wind speed, and average of Maximum Wind Speed. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher Civil Aviation Authority. Its tags are pressure, wind, climate, weather, airport. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-09-12 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and air transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
